messages:
inez: Heads-up: Product wants the migration probe to be non-billable by default for tenants in the next pilot. Finance pushback expected. Need quick decision on consent UX + accounting tags.

carter: Summary of options: 1) mark probe requests tag `probe.free=true` and accounting ignores them, 2) bill normally and issue credits after the fact, 3) ask tenants to opt-in to billed probes via checkbox.

linh: Tech notes: router can tag probe requests easily. Accounting change to ignore tag is moderate effort and needs finance approval. Billing team prefers manual credits to avoid touchpoints in ledger code.

amala: UX: prefer non-billable probes to lower friction. Proposed copy: "Run a free compatibility probe: we will execute selected requests on v2 for diffs and not bill those probe runs." Add small consent checkbox and a recorded audit entry.

billing-bot: billing-bot: policy: we cannot silently stop billing without contract changes for enterprise customers. For pilot tenants we can do manual credits but need a finance ticket and audit trail.

inez: Can we do a hybrid? Default probes non-billable for tenants on trial/standard plans, enterprise tenants get shown the consent checkbox and explanation that probes may be billed.

carter: Implementation detail: add header `X-Redwood-Probe: true` and router tags `probe.mode=console` + `probe.free=true|false`. Accounting will read tag. If finance opts out, router still sends tag but `probe.free=false`.

linh: Also need to ensure token double-counting doesn't happen when we run parallel probe executions. If we execute both v1 and v2 for the same incoming request, mark the secondary run as `probe.secondary` and make it non-billable.

amala: Console UX: modal with 3 toggles: "Run probe (free)", "Include sample prompts", "Record results to Migration Log". For enterprise plans show an extra checkbox: "I consent to billed probes" with link to billing FAQ.

inez: Also require an audit entry for consent with timestamp and user id. Legal wants the consent entry persisted for 7 years.

billing-bot: billing-bot: finance request: provide a short RFC describing expected token volume for pilot, estimated credit amount, and tenant list. We'll approve manual credits for the pilot if numbers are reasonable.

carter: Telemetry we need: probe.count, probe.free.count, probe.regressions, probe.tokens_billed, probe.tokens_total. Exportable by migration.batch_id.

linh: Ops: add guardrail: if probe.free=true and probe.tokens_total for tenant > 100k in 1h, auto-disable probes for that tenant and alert finance/product.

amala: Good. Also show a timeline in console indicating probe status, last run, regressions %, and a small badge if probe was billed. Keep language clear: "This probe was billed" vs "This probe was free".

console-bot: console-bot: PR opened for modal mockup: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4872 - includes consent checkbox and audit pingback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: router canary started for config=probe-tagging v=2026-11-03-canary by linh

inez: Action items: carter -> write RFC for finance with pilot estimates (today), linh -> router tags + secondary-run non-billable (12h), amala -> console modal copy + mockups (24h), finance -> review RFC and confirm manual credits process.

carter: One more Q: if a tenant runs a probe and sees regressions, do we automatically pause their migration attempts or leave control to tenant? Product prefers automatic pause on regressions > 5% but only if tenant gave consent to automatic safety actions.

amala: UX: add small toggle "Allow automatic safety rollback" default off. If on, we will auto-pause migrations on threshold breaches and log action in audit.

inez: Legal: automatic safety rollback is fine but must be opt-in for enterprise accounts.

billing-bot: billing-bot: noted. finance needs the opt-in list in RFC.

linh: Canary metrics look good so far: probe.tagging fired, no double-count, and `probe.secondary` marked non-billable. Monitoring for token spikes enabled.

inez: Thanks team. Let's keep pilot small until finance confirms credits. Will re-open thread if RFC flagged.
